def build_environ(scope: Scope, body: bytes) ->dict[str, typing.Any]:

    environ["wsgi.errors"] = sys.stdout
    environ["wsgi.url_scheme"] = scope["scheme"]
    environ["wsgi.multithread"] = True
    environ["wsgi.multiprocess"] = True
    environ["wsgi.run_once"] = False
    environ["wsgi.version"] = (1, 0)

    environ["SERVER_NAME"] = scope["server"][0]
    environ["SERVER_PORT"] = scope["server"][1]
    environ["SERVER_PROTOCOL"] = f"HTTP/{scope['http_version']}"
    environ["SCRIPT_NAME"] = scope["root_path"].encode("utf-8").decode("latin-1")
    if scope.get("client") is not None:
        environ["REMOTE_ADDR"] = scope["client"][0]
    
    # Handle headers properly
    header_dict = {}
    for name, value in scope["headers"]:
        name_str = name.decode("latin-1").upper().replace("-", "_")
        value_str = value.decode("latin-1")
        if name_str in header_dict:
            header_dict[name_str] = f"{header_dict[name_str]},{value_str}"

            header_dict[name_str] = value_str
    
    for name, value in header_dict.items():

        elif name == "CONTENT_LENGTH":

    return environ
